what: Committed forbidden-path check uses exact path match only
scenario_or_breakage: `post_dispatch_forbidden_revert` rejects `forbidden_path/*`, but the proposed `awk '($0 in forbidden)'` only matches exact paths; a commit touching `submodule/foo/bar` can pass when `submodule/foo` is listed
suggested_fix: Reuse the same prefix rules as `post_dispatch_forbidden_revert` (or factor a shared helper) when scanning `git diff --name-only "$baseline_head".."$current_head"`
